content: We first consider a simple query matching baseline similar to the IR baseline in Kocisk2017TheNR. But instead of only considering several genres of spans as potential answers, we try to match the question with all possible spans in the tweet context and choose the span with the highest BLEU-1 score as the final answer, which follows the method and implementation of answer span selection for open-domain QA BIBREF19 . We include this baseline to show that TweetQA is a nontrivial task which cannot be easily solved with superficial text matching.
